column1: # Claims of concepts-works-flow.svg and "One key and one byte of output" in docs/concepts/how-vtium-works.md.
vtium-term encodes the key as bytes
the pty: the session's program reads it
the pty: vtium's side has bytes to read
vtium-platform reads them and hands them on
vtium takes the frame and a buffer
vtium-render composes the frame in it, on the render thread
vtium gives the buffer back to show
vtium-platform: a page flip on KMS/DRM
